speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned intense itching and red bumps on your thigh; how long have these symptoms been present, and have you noticed any new medications, insect bites, or changes in your environment recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. The patient has recently attended a business conference in Miami. He has a past medical history of hypertension, diabetes type 2, and hyperlipidemia. The patient’s medication regimen includes enalapril, metformin, and atorvastatin. He denies any history of smoking or drinking.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies. The patient's intense itching, red bumps, recent travel, and specific medication history (atorvastatin, enalapril) are highly suggestive, particularly if the itching is worse at night. I need to confirm if the bumps have burrows or if anyone else he lives with is itchy. Please describe the appearance of the bumps in detail and check your bed partner for similar symptoms.
